quantifiers: All real recurrence parameters and n0 are fixed before the existential coefficients and final universal natural input. The explicit witness theorem retains N, actual finite-prefix supremum and both source quotients as lets in its statement.
domains_and_signs: a,c>0, a+c<1, C1>=0. f,b,d,C2,C4 may be signed. No monotonicity, positivity of f or offset positivity. Nat.ceil is the existing zero-truncated natural ceiling.
prefix: Sharp induction requires the independently established finite prefix f(n)<=C4 for n<=N, with n0<=N. The witness theorem discharges it through the actual Finset.sup of the nonempty range 0..N; the prefix maximum is not replaced by max 0.
descent: The old exact signed-offset ceiling theorem supplies both strictly smaller children. Induction hypotheses are applied only after these decreases; totality of the scalar function remains a given domain fact.
slope_and_denominator: The old slope theorem derives C3>=0; its sharp step derives the positive second denominator from the exact cutoff. Both source slope inequalities are nonstrict.
natural_bridge: Cast the actual Nat recurrence using congrArg plus standard cast laws, apply the real theorem, then use Nat.le_ceil for each real witness; no positivity assumption on the witnesses or second induction.
